title: Edgar Mitchell's UFO squadron over Germany and the footage taken

tellings.quote: Edgar Mitchell who was a naval astronaut who said that in a in a training Mission over Germany he saw over multiple days saw a squadron of like n UFOs that that flew in all these different formations and he had footage of them they said that when he got back to the US in Washington as soon as he landed a military plane landed took the footage never heard about it again

plain: The astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have seen a whole squadron of UFOs on a training mission over Germany, over several days, flying in many different formations, and to have filmed them. According to the story, when he landed back in Washington a military plane landed right after him, the footage was taken away, and he never heard about it again. Michels tells this as something Mitchell said, and offers it as an example of evidence being quietly taken.
